name: drop
steps: log set down broken on WELLSPRING (off the pad) and radio home base, hands off: autopilot flies MULE 1 in

eval (()=>{ const I=__G.ISLANDS.find(i=>i.name==='WELLSPRING'); let best=null; for(let a=0;a<6.28;a+=0.3) for(let r=8;r<60;r+=4){ const x=I.x+Math.cos(a)*r, z=I.z+Math.sin(a)*r, h=__G.terrainH(x,z); if(h>2 && Math.hypot(x-I.pad.x,z-I.pad.z)>18 && (!best||Math.abs(h-I.pad.h)<Math.abs(best.h-I.pad.h))) best={x,z,h}; } __G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(best.x, best.h+1.2, best.z), 0, true, 0); __G.D.hp.rotor=0.3; __G.D.hp.tail=0.2; __G.G.fuel=8; window.__b=best; return best })()

eval (window.__fl=[], window.__flI=setInterval(()=>{ const M=__G.drop.state; if(!M||M.plane.gone) return; const S=M.plane.sim; __fl.push([Math.round(S.p.y), Math.round(S.V), +S.bank.toFixed(2), +S.alpha.toFixed(3), Math.round(Math.hypot(S.p.x-M.target.x,S.p.z-M.target.z))]); }, 2000), 1)
log manual: take MULE 1 off autopilot, fly it, hand back, jump on the green light
